prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-29, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-29):
Fiscal period 2026 Q3 (filed 2026-04-29). Revenue 82,886M, gross margin 68%, operating income 38,398M (operating margin 46%), net income 31,778M, diluted EPS 4.27. Total assets 694,228M, total liabilities 279,861M, shareholders' equity 414,367M. Current assets 175,329M vs current liabilities 136,661M (current ratio 1.28), retained earnings 302,526M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported metrics indicate exceptional profitability (46% operating margin), very low leverage (equity of $414B far exceeds total liabilities), solid liquidity, and scale consistent with the highest-grade non-financial corporates. These characteristics map to the upper end of the investment-grade spectrum but fall short of the rare, near risk-free profile required for AAA.
DECISION: AA+
